initialSetupModal.epicNotFound: Could not locate Epic Games apps data. Please ensure the selected path is correct.
initialSetupModal.epicInstructions:
To find the correct folder:
1. Open Epic Games Launcher
2. Go to Settings → Go to Download Settings → Scroll down to Advanced
3. Under Fab Library Data Cache Directory, you will see a path on your computer. The default value for this is C:/ProgramData/Epic/EpicGamesLauncher/VaultCache
4. The Manifests folder is located one level up in ../Data/Manifests by default. This can look like C:/ProgramData/Epic/EpicGamesLauncher/Data/Manifests

initialSetupModal.backupImportWarning:
You are importing a DEADFORGE Backup Archive. This automatically skips any other setup steps, like importing Steam, Epic and itch paths.
You can revisit this setup again after the backup import is complete from <0>Settings</0> → <1>App Data & Updates</1> → <2>Initial Setup</2> → <3>Replay Setup</3>.
initialSetupModal.backupFileNotFound: It seems like your backup file has been deleted / moved since you selected it. Please, correct its path in the previous step before continuing.
initialSetupModal.finishInstructions:
Click "Finish" to start importing your games and data. The app will restart automatically.
Additional game library assets may be downloaded as part of the import process.
This process is fully automatic. Any updates to your imported libraries will be automatically processed, and their assets will also be downloaded in the future.
